phasesSeen: Rain outside
A little preparation
Two bowls, freshly served
The first bite
A quiet conversation
One last sip
The counter settles
Read the court
Draw the defender
Find the open wing
Step in and set the shot
Up and through the hoop
Follow the bounce
Return the ball
Good shot
Reset and settle
Read the trail map beneath the cabin eaves
Collect the canteen from the porch shelf
Follow the trail and cross the arched timber bridge
Crouch on the river stone, uncap and refill
Stand, lift the canteen and take a drink
Close the lid and watch a dipper dive for food
Return over the bridge to the trail cabin
Put the canteen back on its shelf
Check the route once more and settle
A quiet halt; the attendant hears the branch train
Railcar emerges from the stone tunnel and brakes
Doors slide apart; the passenger steps onto the platform
Passenger approaches and presents a ticket
The attendant clips the ticket; a small nod
Passenger returns aboard and the doorway closes
A raised paddle clears the returning branch service
Railcar retreats into the tunnel; the attendant walks back
The attendant sits; the little station settles
Row into the sheltered inlet
Stow oars and step onto the jetty
Climb the two coastal stairways
Open the cabinet and wind the beacon
Close and latch the winding cabinet
Descend to the waiting skiff
Recover the painter and board
Row out and turn beside the buoy
Settle into the starting composition
